name: Meeting action item
notes: Mining: mostly a source; most meeting intents become A11, C3 or C4 work.

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: An action item comes out of a meeting transcript.

steps.name: Task the action
steps.means: The client agent does the action item.

steps.name: Ben rules on the work
steps.means: Only if the work raised a choice: Ben rules on it before any reply goes out.
steps.gate: Ben rules on what the work raised before any reply

sla.why: refit to p75 of 16 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Reply or deliverable
steps.means: The client agent drafts the reply or the deliverable; nothing is sent.

steps.name: Ben closes it
steps.means: Ben sends or presents it; that closes the case.
